title: Redesain Chatbot Arsip & Kontrak PT Bumi Siak Pusako
prompt:
Redesign this Indonesian enterprise document & contract AI assistant chatbot ("Chatbot Arsip Dokumen & Kontrak - Berbasis RAG & Groq AI") into a modern, highly polished, premium corporate mobile interface for "PT Bumi Siak Pusako / skkmigas".

Key elements to include:
1. Top Header / App Bar:
- Incorporate the agency logo {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_1}} (Bumi Siak Pusako & SKK Migas) cleanly in the header with high quality styling.
- Clear title: "Asisten AI Arsip & Kontrak" with subtitle "PT Bumi Siak Pusako • RAG & Groq AI".
- Status indicator pill badge: glowing green dot with text "Sistem Aktif" or "Model Siap".
- Action icons: Reset / New Chat icon, options/info button.

2. Chat Stream / Message History:
- Date separator: "Hari ini, 24 Mei 2024"
- System greeting message bubble with an elegant bot avatar (sleek AI/document badge), formatted nicely with bold highlights and clear spacing:
  "Halo! Saya asisten AI untuk penelusuran dokumen kontrak dan verifikasi pembayaran PT Bumi Siak Pusako. Silakan tanyakan nomor kontrak, termin pembayaran, atau nilai SPK."
- User message bubble: "Berapa nomor transaksi pembayaran termin 1?" with timestamp 09:37 and read checkmark.
- AI assistant reply bubble with structured, rich card layout:
  - Text response: "Nomor transaksi pembayaran termin 1 adalah **V-PAY/2024/03/0088**."
  - Source citation / verification pill card: clickable chip icon with "Sumber: pembayaran_045_termin_1.txt" and "Preview Dokumen" link.
  - Quick action buttons on bot reply: Copy, Thumbs up, Thumbs down, Unduh Ringkasan.

3. Quick Suggestion Pills / Chips (Horizontal scrollable or neat row):
- "💻 Kontrak Laptop", "🏢 Sewa Gedung", "🧾 Bukti Pembayaran", "📋 Verifikasi Termin 2" with modern border and hover/press micro-interactions.

4. Input Bar at Bottom:
- Elevated or floating bottom bar.
- Attachment/Upload document button (paperclip icon).
- Input field: "Ketik pertanyaan terkait kontrak di sini..."
- Voice input / Mic button.
- Primary gradient/vibrant send button with paper plane icon.

Visual Design & UX Polish:
- Theme: Professional corporate mobile app with clean white/slate-50 background, subtle enterprise blue/navy accents, sophisticated typography, soft shadows, rounded-2xl cards.
- Mobile viewport optimized (~390px width layout feel).
- All text in Indonesian, exactly reflecting corporate oil & gas governance standards.
